title: ChatContact.id = userId: collapse tailscale_user_id, remove mailbox_host from JMAP type
description:
The I-D specifies that ChatContact.id IS the userId from the auth layer — no separate identity namespace. Currently the Contact struct has both id (server-assigned) and tailscale_user_id (the real identity), plus mailbox_host which belongs in the federation spec.

The DB already uses peer_user_id as the primary key, so id and tailscale_user_id map to the same value. This is mostly a struct simplification.

mailbox_host stays in the DB (needed for outbox delivery routing) but must not appear in the JMAP ChatContact response.

Files to touch:
- kith-core/src/contact.rs: remove tailscale_user_id field, remove mailbox_host field from struct
- kith-store/src/contact.rs: peer_mailbox_host stays in DB row but not mapped into ChatContact; delivery code gets it separately
- kith-core/Cargo.toml: remove sha2 dep (freed when compute_chat_id is removed in the chat ID issue)
- kith-peer/src/lib.rs: upsert still needs mailbox_host for routing, passed separately

Depends on: KITH-phdk (rename must happen first)
